project_type: Spring Boot 3.2.0 backend + React 18 + Vite 5 frontend, REST API with JWT auth
build_system: Maven 3.x (backend), npm/Vite (frontend). H2 database already in pom.xml dependencies.
test_framework: JUnit/Spring Test (backend), no tests in frontend currently
build_command: Backend: mvn clean install -DskipTests; Frontend: npm install && npm run build
test_command: Backend: mvn test; Frontend: npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Backend compile: mvn clean compile (must succeed). 2. Backend run: mvn spring-boot:run (default MySQL) or mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2 (H2 fallback). 3. Verify Swagger UI at http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html. 4. Frontend: npm run dev, access http://localhost:5173. 5. Test login with farmer (9876543210/Farmer@123) and buyer (9876543211/Buyer@123). 6. Test GET /api/crops/my-crops as farmer (JWT required). 7. Test GET /api/farmers/map (public, no auth).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Maven produces target/ and npm produces dist/, but these are not checked in.
environment_constraints: MySQL may not be running on localhost:3306 with credentials root/vyshu092007, hence H2 fallback profile is needed. Backend runs on port 8080, frontend on 5173. CORS allowed origin is http://localhost:5173 in application.properties.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found in this project. Standard Spring Boot + React patterns apply. All Java classes use Lombok annotations. DTOs follow naming convention *Dto.java in com.agribridge.dto package. Controllers use Swagger @Operation annotations. Repository methods follow Spring Data JPA naming conventions.
key_patterns: Backend: Entity classes in com.agribridge.entity with Lombok @Data/@Builder, Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository in com.agribridge.repository, Service classes in com.agribridge.service with @Service and constructor injection via @RequiredArgsConstructor, Controllers in com.agribridge.controller with @RestController and @RequestMapping, JWT auth uses UserDetails from authenticated principal cast to User entity. Frontend: React functional components with hooks, Axios API calls in src/services/api.js, React Router for navigation, Leaflet maps via react-leaflet, localStorage for JWT token and role.
